en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad, tree‑lined residential street with ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century townhouses or villas. The façades feature steep gables, dormer windows, decorative stonework, and a tall, narrow spire with a tiled roof, giving the street a Central‑European, Wilhelminian look. A few lampposts and utility poles line the sidewalk; a man in a hat stands on the right near a small cart. The street recedes downhill toward a wooded or semi‑rural background. No visible title, caption, or postal markings appear on the image side.
